summary: Improve job design, manager coaching and recognition practices. Explore this employee engagement training course and plan team-level action.
lede: Employee engagement training helps supervisors and HR practitioners connect motivation concepts to everyday job design and manager routines. You’ll map motivation drivers, assess role features, clarify goals, and practise recognition, SBI feedback and GROW coaching conversations. The course also addresses how hybrid work shapes autonomy, connection and feedback, then guides learners to build an engagement action plan with owners, milestones and review points.
audienceIntro: If your role shapes how people experience their work, this foundation course helps you connect motivation concepts to team routines, job design and manager conversations.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace team interactions is useful. No prior HR theory or coding and programming skills are required.
